title: Evaluator projection, endpoint, owed-partition, import/test, and comparator registry (DRAFT, isolated successor)
description: Machine-readable law for G3/G4/G5 atom evaluation. Does not edit relation-payload-schemas.v2.json, policy-document.schema.json, imported-evidence.schema.json, identity-schemas.v2.json, or repair.schema.json. Root integrates. Standing: draft only.
standing: DRAFT isolated successor. Frozen21 and live repo untouched. No source assent. G3-G5 not closed until root review and route-registry integration.

engineFamilies.standing: Compatibility for OWED incoming admitted-target partitions. Matching of already-admitted facts is independent and must not drop cross-program or cross-family facts that exist.

crossFamilyOwedEdges.label: NEW ATOM_CROSS_FAMILY_EDGE_NOT_OWED
crossFamilyOwedEdges.positives: Existing admitted-target facts whose sourceUniverse and targetUniverse differ in family STILL MATCH if native IDs and kinds match; they are not deleted.
crossFamilyOwedEdges.negatives: Incoming absence does not owe cross-family sources. Disclose cause cross-family-edge-not-owed on negative completeness. Do not emit an empty global semantic claim that no cross-family edges exist.

evaluationSubject.whyKind: file and package nativeIds can collide as paths vs package names; kind is required. Same packageName at two first-party manifests is two subjects; file/symbol shape unchanged.

exportLaw.exportSelection: PolicyDocumentV1.rules[].subjectEnumeration.subjectKind=export already means: enumerate symbol inventory rows with exported=exported, including incoming-target rules whose current subjects are those exported symbols. Filter field subjectKind/targetKind MUST NOT accept the token export in this version (NEW ATOM_FILTER_ENUM_LITERAL_UNKNOWN). v1/v2 virtual-kind mapping is withdrawn.

package.sourceOccupancy: payload.packageName AND payload.manifestPath must equal evaluation-subject nativeSubjectId and packageManifestPath; native scope membership remains packageName

vcs-change.note: previousPath is historical not-joined; not a target endpoint.

declares.sourceFieldNote: Primary occupancy is payload.declared (the enumerated declared identity). payload.container is a related source-side identity of the same fact, not a second current-subject occupancy and not a FieldFilter field (no hidden container filter).
declares.note: container is parent, not target endpoint.

types.note: checkedType is a type identity, not a target subject. No TargetAttributionV1.

calls.note: calleeText is not a native id. endpoint=target at syntactic-callee-name is ATOM_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE.

filters.subject: payload.caller
filters.subjectKind: source-endpoint-kind (caller inventory kind; incoming uses SOURCE attribution, not current target.kind)

references.note: name is not a native id.

filters.subject: payload.referrer
filters.subjectKind: source-endpoint-kind (referrer inventory kind; incoming uses SOURCE attribution, not current target.kind)

imports.note: endpoint=target admission uses TARGET kinds {file,symbol,package}, not source subjectKind symbol. specifier is not a native id.

filters.subject: payload.importer
filters.subjectKind: source-endpoint-kind (importer inventory kind; incoming uses SOURCE attribution, not current target.kind)

unresolved-edge.note: targetModule is nullable text; targetScope is not targetKind. Filter field target projects targetModule as string (null => unknown). No TargetAttributionV1 subject-id occupancy.

runtime-observation.enumerationExport: selects symbol rows with exported=exported, then projects like symbol

subject.file: RuntimeSubject.path (exact LogicalPath; occupancy requires symbol ABSENT)
subject.symbol: RuntimeSubject.symbol (exact string; occupancy requires path==inventory.path AND symbol==inventory.qualifiedName)
subject.note: No concatenated path-and-symbol scalar. Enumeration occupancy still uses path+name together with repair ambiguity refusal if two rows match one E in one wrapper.

kindApplicability.endpointSource: Atom.endpoint default source (or omitted). Rule subjectEnumeration.subjectKind file|symbol|package must be in relation.sourceSubjectKind / sourceSubjectKinds. subjectEnumeration.subjectKind=export is lawful iff the relation admits symbol (export selects exported symbols).
kindApplicability.endpointTarget: Uses relation.targetKinds, NOT sourceSubjectKind. Rule kind file|symbol|package must be a member of targetKinds. export enumerates exported symbols and is lawful iff targetKinds contains symbol. Unary relations and unresolved-edge: ATOM_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE. calls/references/imports at a rung that forbids the resolved-* field: ATOM_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE.

owedPartitions.parameter: foundation/enumeration-plan.schema.v1.json EnumerationPlanV1 (already a Plan parameter). Program bindings carry universe H or universe=null unavailable.
owedPartitions.atomCapability: capabilityForRelation[atom.relation]. Cells whose capabilityId equals that id AND whose programBindings are the Plan-selected native programs for that capability.
owedPartitions.owedSourcePrograms: ALL programBindings of those cells. Available binding: universe H is an owed source universe. Unavailable binding (universe=null): unknown obligation (does not become empty).

outgoing.bind: sourceUniverse=current evaluation universe U; current subject occupies sourceField
outgoing.scopes: every selected subject-scope of (relation, minResolution, sourceUniverse=U) that contains the current source subject. Do NOT invent coverage keys for target universes T merely because admitted-target allows T and no edge to T was observed. same-only implies targetUniverse=U. Existing facts with any admitted targetUniverse still match.
outgoing.examination: per-source-universe exhaustive examination of independently enumerated source subjects (SubjectInventoryV1 + scopes). Missing expected source subjects or missing Coverage entry for the owed (relation,minResolution,U,*) => unknown.

incoming.bind: current E=(U,K,N) occupies the target native-id field after native-id compare; fact.targetUniverse must equal U for a MATCH. Owed SOURCE programs are EnumerationPlan bindings, NEVER the set of fact.sourceUniverse values.
incoming.owedSources: every same-family owed source program, including those with zero matching facts. Unavailable binding remains an unknown obligation.
incoming.scopes: ALL selected scopes of (relation, minResolution-or-above on that ladder, sourceUniverse=S) REGARDLESS of scope.targetUniverse. Do NOT require a scope or Coverage key (S, targetUniverse=U). That would demand an empty Cartesian (S,U) record when S searched other targets. coveragePartitionLaw disjointness is per full key (snapshot, relation, resolution, sourceUniverse, targetUniverse), not global-S.
incoming.sourcePresence: Union of independently enumerated SOURCE subjects appearing in those S-scopes. A source subject may appear in multiple targetUniverse partitions; UNION presence, never SUM of counts across T.
incoming.matchingFacts: facts whose actual targetUniverse=U and target nativeId=N (and kind reconciled). Presence of facts with other T does not omit owed S.
incoming.absence: Native ClosedWorldV2 / unresolved-edge affected-target law (sufficiency_v2 universal-negative) about current target U, evaluated against REPRESENTED partitions of S (actual CoverageResultV3 records). Missed expected source subject of S => unknown. Do not invent an empty Coverage (S,U).
incoming.attestation: If no CoverageResultV3 with key.targetUniverse=U exists for S at this relation@rung, incoming none/count-at-most-true/all-covered MUST NOT infer that S searched U. Require typed IncomingSearchAttestationV1 for (S, relation, minResolution, U) or report source-target-search-unattested. Attestation is an admitted input, not inferred from producer facts.
incoming.unknownIf: unavailable owed binding; uncovered expected source subjects of S; no represented partition and no IncomingSearchAttestationV1; coverage unknown/partial/not-attempted on represented partitions relevant to absence; resolution-incomplete under sufficiency_v2 at requested rung

allCovered.requestedRung: atom.minResolution only, never all higher rungs
allCovered.call: Must call native sufficiency_v2 at the requested rung, including confidence floor, types derivationPolicy, and DEPENDS_ON. Not merely coverage=complete and examinedExhaustive.
allCovered.notApplicable: On non-resolved rungs, resolutionCompleteness.state=not-applicable is the RC-1 value. sufficiency_v2 quantifier=existential, completeness=complete (step 5 still requires coverage=complete; step 6-7 skipped).
allCovered.resolved: On the five resolved rungs, sufficiency_v2 quantifier=universal-negative, completeness=complete so RC-2 resolution-complete and closed-world/unresolved-edge steps RUN. This is not weaker than v3.
allCovered.incoming: sufficiency_v2 is applied per owed source S against that source's represented view entry (or attestation). Cross-family facts may still make exists true; they do not satisfy incoming all-covered/none for unowed families.

importObservationNullLaw.rule: Required keys; null member means the observation semantics do not apply to the kind. Do not read selection.completenessEstablished for runtime/history.

inObservationalScope.all-paths: path is in wrapper ImportScopeDescriptor extent intersect snapshot inventory
inObservationalScope.in-scope-paths: that extent intersect plan.scope-descriptor (and ScopeDocumentV1 globs when the Plan selected that parameter)
inObservationalScope.listed-paths: path is a HistorySubject.path in THIS payload. A path not listed is out of scope (history-outside-collection-scope), not examined-absent

runtimeSubjectOrder.notCanonicalSetOfWholeRows: whole-row canonical-set would sort by hits/observability first and CHANGE established order. Forbidden as a replacement.
runtimeSubjectOrder.comparator: UTF-8 path ascending; then absent-symbol BEFORE present-symbol; then UTF-8 symbol when present

annotationProposal.standing: NEW comparator token pending canonical.py vocabulary integration; until then the comparator is this registry plus imported-evidence prose

testRowOrder.choice: unique testId admission is deliberately required so test-case ordinal addresses plus testId are unambiguous. Duplicate testId refuses NEW TEST_PAYLOAD_DUPLICATE_TEST_ID. Sequence is NOT rewritten to canonical-set.

importQuantifiers.owedWrappers: every Plan-SELECTED import2 of the atom evidenceKind that is relevant to the current subject (wrapper scope intersects current logicalPath / history observational scope). NOT merely proof.evaluationInputRefs. A selected relevant wrapper omitted from evaluationInputRefs cannot hide uncertainty on negatives.
importQuantifiers.consumable: mapped current (StalenessRule current); unmapped-only never feeds polarity set R

polaritySetR.observabilityFilter: may select disclosure of unobservable/unmapped rows; MUST NOT put them in R; MUST NOT make exists true

kleene.exists: true if any owed consumable wrapper contributes a polarity match, even if siblings are partial/incomplete
kleene.none: false if any known polarity match exists, even if another wrapper is partial. True only if every OWED relevant wrapper is observationally complete AND R is empty. Else indeterminate.
kleene.count-at-most: false once known distinct ObservationAddress count > N, even if siblings partial. True only if every owed relevant wrapper is complete AND count <= N. Else indeterminate when count <= N.
kleene.all-covered: true only if every owed relevant wrapper is complete AND every selected current subject has a covering row (runtime observed-hit or observable-unhit; history in-scope subject row). Never false.

importQuantifiers.runtimeComplete: wrapper.completeness=complete AND observation.window non-null AND population present AND population != unknown. This does NOT establish observability of a missing, unobservable, or unmapped subject.
importQuantifiers.runtimeNegativeRow: none/count-at-most true and all-covered additionally require an exact consumable mapped polarity row at the current grain (observed-hit or observable-unhit). Wrapper-complete with no row, or only an unobservable/unmapped row, is unknown (unobservable-subject / no-consumable-row), not true.

historyAbsence.all-paths: path in wrapper scope extent: examined absence MAY be true with ZERO HistorySubject rows. all-covered MUST NOT require a HistorySubject row.
historyAbsence.in-scope-paths: same, using in-scope extent. No row is unchanged/examined-absent if the path is in that extent.
historyAbsence.listed-paths: current path absent from subjects[] is OUTSIDE collection (history-outside-collection-scope) => unknown for required coverage, NOT a dropped owed wrapper and NOT vacuous true

importQuantifiers.zeroOwedWrappers: explicit empty owed set => cause evidence-kind-unavailable (unknown). Never vacuous true.
importQuantifiers.wrapperRelevance: Decide owed wrappers from declared wrapper scope / ImportScopeDescriptor / collectionScope BEFORE looking at listed payload rows. A listed-paths payload does not shrink the owed wrapper set to empty.
importQuantifiers.testComplete: wrapper.completeness=complete AND current/mapped correspondence AND ImportObservationV1.selection.completenessEstablished==true (and payload.selection equal). wrapper.completeness=partial blocks none/all-covered true even if process result is known.
importQuantifiers.staleness: Source/build/mapping/staleness admission is the existing import owner. This model consumes only already-admitted consumable vs unmapped-only flags. No global trusted-complete flag.
importQuantifiers.optionalRequired: Atom returns cause set only. Root maps required/optional evidenceUse to gating. optional-absent is indeterminate + non-gating disclosure. NEVER called retained no-match. Causes are a SET.

processResult.failed: else exitStatus!=0 OR any tests[].outcome==fail; if any tests[].outcome==error, error takes precedence over failed
processResult.passed: else exitStatus==0. This is the process result, NOT a proof that all intended tests ran.

testResultLaw.emptyTestsNonzeroExit: tests=[] AND exitStatus==1 is a consumable failed test-execution scope observation
testResultLaw.test-execution: COARSE claim: applies to selected evaluation subjects whose inventory logicalPath is in the wrapper ImportScopeDescriptor. No synthetic per-subject failure.
testResultLaw.test-result: binds ONLY tests[] rows that carry subjectPath. Unassigned rows (no subjectPath) are accounted only via the execution summary (test-execution), never attributed to a file.
testResultLaw.completeness: TestPayloadV1.selection.completenessEstablished (and matching ImportObservationV1.selection) governs completeness claims (none/all-covered/count-at-most true). Known process outcome may still make exists true / none false when completenessEstablished=false.
testResultLaw.noImplicitExecution: Requires an admitted test-execution step or producer=independent-prepared import. No implied repository spawn.

globPrefix.prefix: UTF-8 byte prefix of the projected scalar string. Empty prefix is schema-illegal (minLength 1).
globPrefix.glob: Same GlobPattern as PolicyDocumentV1 include/exclude: only *, ? and whole-segment **. Evaluated on the projected string.
globPrefix.enumerationGlobs: subjectEnumeration include/exclude match retained inventory logicalPath (InventoryRowV1.path), never SubjectIdV1 spelling and never universe H.
globPrefix.symbolSubjectFilterGlob: FieldFilter glob/prefix on field=subject for a symbol current subject uses inventory logicalPath when the projection is a path; when the projection is nativeSubjectId, glob is on that exact string.

impossibleLiteral.eqNeqInOnClosedEnum: If the filter value (or each in[] member) is not a member of that field's closed value set AT THIS relation, admission refuse ATOM_FILTER_ENUM_LITERAL_UNKNOWN (NEW/internal). Includes subjectKind/targetKind token export, observability tokens on history, testResult spelling from the other grain.
impossibleLiteral.prefixGlobOnEnum: patterns are not enum members; admitted; match if the actual token string matches.
impossibleLiteral.universe: CLOSED ENUM of engineFamilies.portableUniverseDomains. A value not in that set (including 64-hex and sha256:) is ATOM_FILTER_ENUM_LITERAL_UNKNOWN at admission. Valid domain tokens use NORMAL comparators: eq of two different valid domains is false; neq of two different valid domains is TRUE; prefix/glob are UTF-8 string ops on the domain token. Universe filter projects the selected ENDPOINT's portable domain (sourceUniverse domain for endpoint=source, targetUniverse domain for endpoint=target). Never merge H identities. Never treat neq as universal nomatch.
impossibleLiteral.resolutionEq: value must be a member of THIS atom relation's ladder or ATOM_FILTER_ENUM_LITERAL_UNKNOWN.

targetKind.unknownKind: targetAttribution.kind=unknown => filter result unknown (indeterminate matching), not nomatch

fieldFilterSuccessor.standing: Proposed successor of policy-document FieldFilter. Root integrates. Integer arrays are lawful ONLY for field=exitStatus AND cmp=in. String arrays for every other in.

observationAddress.importId: import2: hex; binds the exact wrapper/payload
observationAddress.ordinal: 0-based index into RuntimePayloadV1.subjects / HistoryPayloadV1.subjects / TestPayloadV1.tests in the retained sequence; null iff selector=test-execution

witness.optionalUnknown: indeterminate truth + non-gating disclosure; never named retained no-match

repairVsPolicy.noUnknownProducer: admit_evidence_requirement must refuse any imported relation whose repairRequirementProducer is not true. No default producer.

refusals.standing: NEW/internal pending root public-detail / D9 route-registry integration unless noted as existing.

endpoint=target where targetKinds empty or rung forbids resolved field
filter field projection is forbidden for this relation/rung
eq/neq/in value not in closed enum at this relation
cmp not in comparatorTable for the field
label only; not a policy refusal — incoming absence does not owe that source

keys.note: NEW/internal spelling; repair already refuses cross-plane values

NativeCause.description: Copied exact native owner enum native-evidence.schemas.v2.json#/$defs/NativeCause. Root maps AtomCauseV1.nativeCause onto evaluation-deficiency.nativeCause.

AtomCauseCodeV1.description: Closed cause table. Native deficiencies from sufficiency_v2 stay in nativeDeficiencies and use DeficiencyV2 membership; they are NOT overloaded here. Root maps causes + evidenceKind + nativeCause + evidenceUse to evaluation-deficiency. Atom evaluation does not decide gating booleans. New members not yet in identity-schemas.v3 x-opensip-evaluator-deficiency-registry are listed for root registration.

IncomingSearchAttestationV1.description: Canonical record is incoming-search.schema.v1.json. Globally admitted by own registered relation/rung. ResolutionCompletenessV2 and ClosedWorldV2 are copied exact native owner types. examinedExhaustive=false never proves complete search. expectedInventoryRefs are raw C inventory hashes, exact source kind/U union.

evidenceKind.description: Import causes carry the atom evidence kind. Native/enumeration/correspondence causes are null. Root maps onto evaluation-deficiency.evidenceKind.

nativeCause.description: Owner NativeCause when the atom retained a typed native carrier; otherwise null. Root maps onto evaluation-deficiency.nativeCause. A null here is not a gating boolean.

AtomSuccessorV1.description: Proposed Atom extension: optional endpoint. Root integrates into policy-document.schema.json. Default source when omitted.
